note: Missing requestId — a claim must name the request it locks.
requestId with characters outside unpadded base64url (padding `=`) must be rejected.
Unknown member — additionalProperties: false rejects an approver-supplied identity in the claim; the member's DID is not revealed until prove.
Step 1 must contain nothing about the starter — a `requester` member is rejected by additionalProperties: false.
An origin with a path is not an origin.
